title: Made a teaser trailer for an open world rpg I’m building
author: legendofvarsha
selftext: Used claude to stitch together elements, including elevenlabs suno gpt

comments.author: legendofvarsha
comments.body: [thelegendofvarsha.com](https://thelegendofvarsha.com) in case anybody wants to see more in game screenshots

comments.author: edm-4-life
comments.body: damn that intro got me excited - nothing against classic old school turn-based rpgs but confused on why you'd generate such high quality cutscenes and then have 1993 graphics for gameplay?

replies.author: legendofvarsha
replies.body:
For purely cinematic purposes, my idea was like the game itself being a parallel to reading a fantasy novel with the higher quality paintings and cutscenes being the readers imagination while reading the story,which are grand , as its a light fantasy world. 

Might not work and ultimately look out of place but let’s see
